title: Community forest reserves and Group rights
rule: A community forest reserve is managed by a Group (an association of people, not necessarily all in one village) rather than a village council alone.
points: Group members' basic rights and duties, unless their agreement with the village council says otherwise: the right to exercise existing rights to enter, occupy, use and harvest forest produce jointly with other Group members, sustainably and under applicable by-laws, rules or agreements; the duty to comply with licence conditions for any activity in the reserve (s.47).
Supervision and monitoring of a community forest reserve follows the same provisions (ss.8 and 41) that apply to other reserve management (s.48(1)).
